TITLE: Set up the Platform Console
DESCRIPTION: Create the first Instance Owner account for this Arclayer deployment.
CREATE_OWNER_DESCRIPTION: This is the one deployment-wide owner. Ownership cannot be assigned as an ordinary platform role.
ACCOUNT_NAME_DESCRIPTION: Use 3–32 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens.
PASSWORD_DESCRIPTION: Use 8–128 characters with at least one letter and one number.
COMPLETE_DESCRIPTION: The account {{owner}} now owns this deployment.
SECURITY_SETUP_REQUIRED_DESCRIPTION: Sign in with this account next, then add and verify a security key or passkey before the Platform Console grants access.
REPAIR_DESCRIPTION: The Console found existing setup information that does not form a safe, complete Instance Owner state. Setup is blocked until the deployment is repaired.
REPAIR_INVALID_INSTALL_RECORD_TITLE: The installation record cannot be verified
REPAIR_INVALID_INSTALL_RECORD_DESCRIPTIO: Ask the deployment operator to inspect and repair the installation record. The Console will not replace or ignore it.
REPAIR_STATE_MISMATCH_TITLE: The owner and installation records do not agree
REPAIR_STATE_MISMATCH_DESCRIPTION: Ask the deployment operator to reconcile the Instance Owner and installation records before continuing.
REPAIR_UNKNOWN_DESCRIPTION: Ask the deployment operator to inspect the setup records. The Console will not guess which state is authoritative.
